source_name: EBA — third-country equivalence assessments (North Macedonia annex)
why_relevant: EU supervisory-authority opinion documents include a North Macedonia equivalence annex assessing supervisory and confidentiality regimes — a rarely-cited but decisive English source on how MK supervision is judged from the EU side.

source_name: Bertelsmann Stiftung BTI — North Macedonia country report
why_relevant: Biennial English governance/market-economy assessment including banking system and financial-market indicators; useful as a slow-moving, independent comparative benchmark alongside IFI reports.

source_name: MK Ministry of Finance — English-language credit-rating page and archive (mirror of agency actions)
source_subtype: government mirror of third-party rating output
why_relevant: Free, dated mirror of Fitch/S&P actions on MK (with English versions on the archive domain and PDF copies of agency updates hosted on state portals) — the practical workaround for the rating agencies' registration walls.

source_name: Vrabotuvanje.com.mk — Macedonian job board (bank & PSP postings)
why_relevant: Largest MK job portal; banks post role-level detail (e.g. Stopanska Banka 'Сектор за картични производи и директно банкарство' agent role) that names departments, channels and sometimes platforms. Hiring for card products, core banking, data engineering or IT security reveals project direction months before disclosure.

source_name: Stopanska Banka AD Skopje — Careers / Кариера во СБ
why_relevant: Primary-source vacancy list of the largest NBG-group bank; ads name org units (Сектор за ИТ, картични производи) and required stacks. Postings also appear in the bank's news feed.

source_name: NLB Banka AD Skopje — press releases / awards & hiring news
why_relevant: NLB is the most award-decorated MK bank (The Banker 'Bank of the Year' x12, EMEA Finance 'Best Digital Bank' CEE). Award press releases enumerate the digital-banking investments made that year — a de facto roadmap disclosure. Its IT ads (data engineering, IT security) show platform direction.

source_name: The Banker — Bank of the Year awards (North Macedonia country winner)
why_relevant: International award whose MK country winner (NLB, 12 times per MK trade press) and citation text is a recurring, dateable competitive marker. Award submissions typically highlight new platforms and channels.

source_name: Global Finance — Best Bank / Best Digital Bank awards, North Macedonia
why_relevant: Names the MK 'Best Bank' (Komercijalna banka for 2025 per MK press) and runs separate digital-bank and trade-finance categories, giving a second independent ranking axis year over year.

source_name: EMEA Finance — Europe Banking Awards (MK winners)
why_relevant: Third award stream; MK coverage reports NLB winning 'Best Bank' (8th time) and 'Best Digital Bank' in CEE for 2025 — useful for triangulating which institution is pushing digital hardest.

source_name: KIBS AD Skopje — clearing house (events, EACHA host, member of MASIT)
why_relevant: KIBS hosted the EACHA annual conference in Skopje; its event participation, agenda topics (account-to-account payments at POS, instant payments interlinking) and hiring reveal national payment-infrastructure direction earlier than regulation does.

source_name: EACHA — European Automated Clearing House Association (annual conference, Skopje edition)
why_relevant: The 2026 annual conference was held in Skopje; agenda and attendee/sponsor lists show which vendors and which MK institutions are positioning around instant payments and A2A at POS.

source_name: MASIT — ICT Chamber of Commerce (members directory + events)
why_relevant: Member directory is a ready-made actor map of MK IT/payments vendors (KIBS, Aspekt, Intertec, Finelevate, Nikofon and others); its forums (e.g. North Macedonia–Greece Digital Bridge & Business ICT Forum, June 2026) publish agendas and partner lists that expose vendor-bank pairings.

source_name: CaSys International — MK card processor (services, clients, careers)
why_relevant: Independent card processor for MK banks (issuing/acquiring, personalisation bureau, e-commerce, 24/7 call centre in mk/en/sq/sr). Its client list, service additions and job ads are a direct read on which banks outsource card processing and what capabilities are being added.

source_name: Joberty — employer profiles & reviews for MK IT/payments companies
why_relevant: Ex-employee reviews, tech-stack tags and salary bands for MK companies such as CaSys; reveals technologies in use and organisational pain points that never appear in corporate communication.

source_name: Pazar3.mk — classifieds, jobs section (Скопје)
why_relevant: Second-tier job channel used by smaller PSPs, fintechs, exchange offices and outsourcers that do not post to vrabotuvanje; catches long-tail actors missing from formal actor maps.

source_name: IT.mk — MK IT news & careers portal
why_relevant: Aggregates MK IT vacancies and covers local tech-company news; useful for catching bank/PSP engineering roles and vendor announcements that the banking press ignores.

source_name: Организација на потрошувачите на Македонија (OPM) — consumer complaints, financial services
why_relevant: The main MK consumer body for financial services: complaint intake ('Пријави проблем'), guidance handbooks on bank/credit disputes, and the 'Фер со потрошувачот' certification. Complaint themes are an early map of product and channel pain points (fees, card disputes, unfair terms).

source_name: Фер со потрошувачот — consumer-fairness certification & e-complaint platform
why_relevant: Electronic complaint submission against certified traders, run with OPM. Which financial institutions carry the mark, and complaint volumes/topics, are a reputational and pain-point signal.

source_name: zastitanapotrosuvaci.mk — state consumer-protection portal
why_relevant: Government-side consumer-protection portal; complements OPM with official guidance, inspection routes and consumer-council material touching financial services.

source_name: НБРСМ — Народна банка: consumer-protection / complaints and payment-security notices
why_relevant: Regulator publishes consumer-protection material on consumer credit, and payment-security notices (e.g. stronger online-payment rules effective 1 March 2026) — these announcements pre-announce compliance projects at every bank and acquirer.

source_name: Македонска банкарска асоцијација (MBA) — activities & event participation
why_relevant: Banking association publishes which conferences its members attend and which working commissions exist (AML/CFT, legal), pointing to sector-wide project themes and to event calendars worth mining for agendas and sponsors.

source_name: Macedonian Stock Exchange annual conference (24th edition) — agenda & participants
why_relevant: The country's main finance/capital-market event; agenda, panelists and sponsor banks indicate which institutions are positioning publicly and on what themes.

source_name: Macedonia2025 Summit — business summit agenda & sponsors
why_relevant: Flagship MK business summit; banks and payment vendors appear as sponsors and panelists, and the sponsor tier list is a cheap read on marketing budgets and strategic positioning.

source_name: Internet Archive Wayback Machine / CDX API — snapshots of MK bank & regulator domains (nbrm.mk, mse.mk, stb.com.mk, nlb.mk, kb.com.mk, sparkasse.mk, halkbank.mk, procreditbank.com.mk)
why_relevant: The single most reliable route to superseded MK bank annual reports, delisted IR pages and removed press releases; the CDX API enumerates every captured PDF URL under a domain, letting historical disclosure series be reconstructed even after live-site redesigns (NBRM and several banks have relocated /content/ PDF paths repeatedly).

source_name: archive.today (archive.ph) — snapshots of MK banking press releases and news pages
why_relevant: Complements Wayback for pages Wayback missed or that were JS-rendered; MK financial news portals and bank newsrooms are frequently saved here by journalists, preserving press releases that banks later pull.

source_name: НБРСМ — WBStorage/Files legacy document store (working papers, strategies, superseded reports)
why_relevant: Deep-linked NBRM file store still serving documents no longer navigable from the live menus (e.g. wp05a.pdf deposit-insurance working paper, the national payment system development strategy). Classic 'orphaned repository' layer for historical payments-policy material.

source_name: SEI-Net — Electronic information system for MSE-listed issuers (disclosure archive)
why_relevant: Statutory repository where listed MK banks (Komercijalna banka, Stopanska banka Bitola/Alta, TTK, Uni banka etc.) file annual reports, quarterly financials, shareholder-meeting materials and price-sensitive announcements. It is the durable archive of exactly the disclosures banks later remove from their own IR pages.
